metadata.case_name: HO KIN LON v. WONG TIN CHI AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: received his education in Hong Kong up to Form 5 level

injuries.description: soft tissue injuries of the neck
source: soft tissue injuries of the neck
tenderness was elicited over right cervical back.
mild tenderness over left side paraspinal muscles of cervical spine

the neck: (a) the joint examination suggested a satisfactory status of the neck; (b) there was no significant muscle spasm of the neck; (c) the range of movement of the neck was satisfactorily preserved; ... (h) the above examination findings suggested that the neck ... had acquired a satisfactory recovery. Residues, if present, would likely be mild; (i) the neck ... condition had reached the stage of maximal medical improvement. Further treatment is not required.
